caseName: Malone Freight Lines, Inc. v. United States
caseNameFull: Malone Freight Lines, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: James W. Wrape, W. H. Brantley, Jr. and Glenn M. Elliott for appellant., Acting Solicitor General Stern and Edward M. Reidy for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission; and Peyton D. Bibb, Reuben G. Crimm, Allan Watkins and Edgar Watkins for Akers Motor Lines, Inc. et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set down for argument.
